purpose: SIM_ONLY physical-step parity of batched frozen SONIC Torch against independent ONNX on eight fixed first-touch courses
simulator: Isaac Sim 6.0.1 / Isaac Lab / PhysX; eight independent 8 m lanes; 300 x 20 ms control frames
dataset_contract: rolling 0.11 m ball; x=2.4/2.6 m, y=+/-0.1 m, vx=+/-0.5 m/s; no real hardware
single_changed_variable: batched Torch target is checked every physical control frame against original per-player ONNX; first shadow-only, then batched drive with ONNX shadow still active
acceptance: Target difference <=0.001 rad on all frames
No loss of original 3/8 clean development contacts
No candidate policy promotion from this test
stop_rules: Abort if source, asset, or qualification differs
Abort if target parity exceeds bound
Abort if pelvis falls below 0.65 m
Count courses, never correlated frames, as samples
